Architecture Consensus: Validate Marcus's OAuth 2.0 token-exchange standard for BYOMCP connectors.

transcript_metadata.captured_by: Google Meet AI Companion & Gemini Cloud Audio

key_transcript_excerpts.speaker: Elena Rostova
key_transcript_excerpts.quote: Marcus, we saw the inference latency spikes in the European cluster during the peak morning hours. Is the $450k H100 expansion going to resolve this without exceeding our cloud gross margin threshold?

key_transcript_excerpts.speaker: Marcus Chen
key_transcript_excerpts.quote: Yes Elena. By provisioning 8 reserved H100 nodes in us-central1 with speculative decoding, p99 latency will drop from 380ms down to 68ms. It keeps our cost per token at $0.00042, well below the $0.00060 margin budget.

key_transcript_excerpts.speaker: Tariq Al-Mansoor
key_transcript_excerpts.quote: From the security and GxP audit side, the OAuth 2.0 token exchange pattern for ServiceNow passes SOC2 Type II, provided tokens expire in 15 minutes and all refresh rotations are stored in GCP Secret Manager.

key_transcript_excerpts.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
key_transcript_excerpts.quote: The enterprise customers are clamoring for the ServiceNow and Veeva demo next week. If we commit to this architecture today, can we guarantee the live workbench will be battle-tested by Tuesday?

key_transcript_excerpts.speaker: Elena Rostova
key_transcript_excerpts.quote: Approved. Let's record the $450k allocation formally, adopt Marcus's token relay spec, and assign the implementation tasks across the pods right now.

stage_2_meeting_transcript_and_summary.executive_summary: In this 60-minute executive alignment session, leadership formally approved the $450,000 Q4 budget allocation for 8x GCP H100 GPU cluster reserve to slash p99 latency to 68ms. The team unanimously ratified the OAuth 2.0 zero-trust token exchange specification for ServiceNow and Veeva BYOMCP connectors with 15-minute token rotation. Four high-priority action items were assigned across Engineering, Product, and Governance with complete accountability and next-step milestones locked for Tuesday's customer keynote.

hard_decisions.summary: Approved $450,000 for 8x H100 GCP reserved nodes in us-central1.
hard_decisions.rationale: Guarantees p99 latency under 75ms and locks token generation costs under budget threshold.

hard_decisions.summary: Ratified OAuth 2.0 token-exchange proxy pattern for all BYOMCP connectors.
hard_decisions.rationale: Eliminates hardcoded credentials and establishes uniform identity propagation across ServiceNow and Veeva.
hard_decisions.sign_off: Marcus Chen (Principal Architect) & Tariq Al-Mansoor (Security Lead)

hard_decisions.summary: Mandated 15-minute token TTL and GCP Secret Manager rotation for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trails.
hard_decisions.rationale: Maintains strict compliance for pharmaceutical life sciences customer deployments.
